t: High adhesion, 2-in-1 paint for use on wall tiles or panelling. Designed for the renovation of high moisture surfaces, including showers. Aquaresist technology creates a durable, waterproof barrier that resists condensation and repeated exposure to water, and withstands temperature variation. The combination of specific polymers with the Additive System offers a high quality finish. Resistant to cleaning products and easy to maintain. Recoatable in 6 hours and fully dry in 48 hours.
